_comment: Hand-authored 'Used for' descriptions, merged by tools/design-system-md.mjs. Fills tokens that have no tokens.css comment and no DSM usage row, and replaces bare 'Alias of …' cells. Plain language for external agents (slides, mockups).
--font-primary: The only typeface in the product: Inter, for every heading, label, value and body text. Use Inter for all text in slides and mockups.
--font-size-base: 16px — default value text: stat values in summary strips, larger body copy, section titles inside cards.
--font-size-4xl: 40px — big display numbers (e.g. a bid countdown). Rare; the product prefers many small facts over one hero number.
--line-height-base: Line height paired with the 16px size.
--line-height-xl: Line height paired with the 20px size.
--line-height-4xl: Line height paired with the 40px display size.
--font-weight-regular: 400 — body text, descriptions, table cell text, timestamps.
--spacing-9: 36px — occasional larger gap between page sections.
--edit-panel-width: Width of the right-side edit drawer that slides over a page.
--main-padding-top-edit: Top padding of the main content area while an edit drawer is open.
--home-grid-columns: Number of columns in the Home dashboard widget grid.
--home-grid-col-min-width: Narrowest a Home dashboard widget column may get before the grid reflows.
--home-grid-row-min-height: Minimum height of one Home dashboard widget row.
--radius-pill: Corner radius for small pill shapes (count chips, toggles).
--icon-size-md: Standard icon size (Lucide line icons) inside buttons, menus and rows.
--shadow-md: Floating surfaces: dropdown menus, popovers, tooltips.
--shadow-up-md: Upward shadow under bars docked to the bottom of the screen (sticky footers, bottom panels).
--shadow-down-lg: Strong downward shadow for elements lifted over content while dragging or expanding.
--transition-slow: Duration of slower motion: panels expanding/collapsing, accordions opening.
--text-secondary-soft: Softer secondary text: supporting lines that sit under a primary label.
--text-inverse-muted: Muted text on dark (navy) surfaces, e.g. secondary info in the top bar.
--bg-inverse: The signature dark navy surface: top navigation bar, primary buttons, dark tooltips. In slides: title bars and emphasis blocks.
--bg-success: Light green background for success messages and success states.
--bg-warning: Very light yellow background for warning messages.
--border-inverse: Dividers and outlines on dark navy surfaces.
--navbar-text: Main text and icons in the dark top navigation bar.
--navbar-text-muted: Secondary text in the top navigation bar (placeholders, hints).
--navbar-search-bg: Background of the search field inside the top navigation bar.
--navbar-search-focus: Focus ring of the top-bar search field.
--navbar-search-dropdown: Background of the search suggestions dropdown under the top bar.
--navbar-divider: Thin separators between groups in the top navigation bar.
--navbar-notification: Red notification count bubble on the bell icon.
--navbar-user-name: User name and role next to the avatar in the top bar.
--btn-primary-bg: Primary button fill — dark navy. The main action on a screen.
--btn-primary-text: Primary button label and icon — white.
--btn-primary-hover: Primary button fill on hover — slightly lighter navy.
--btn-secondary-text: Secondary button label and icon — dark gray.
--input-bg: Background of text inputs, dropdown fields and date fields.
--input-border-focus: Input border while focused — dark navy.
--control-indicator: The check mark / radio dot inside a checked control — white.
--control-label: Text label beside a checkbox or radio.
--panel-border: Card and panel 1px outline — light gray.
--panel-footer-border: Divider line above a card's footer actions.
--badge-yellow-text: Amber/yellow badge text — dark brown-orange on the light yellow fill.
--badge-red-text: Red badge text (failures, errors) on the light red fill.
--badge-purple-bg: Purple badge background — reserved for external (customer-originated) changes.
--badge-purple-text: Purple badge text on the light purple fill.
--dropdown-hover-bg: Highlighted (hovered) option in a dropdown menu.
